quest.title: Garcia's Paean: Key Items
quest.description: Garcia and Lutong seem to be troubled by something...

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: Lutong, my dear Lutong, are you sure... this is the place?

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: Yes, Mr. Garcia, this is where Slimes are most often found.

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: I am most certain of that. However...

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: Would you agree that the Slimes are mildly overwhelming in quantity?

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: Mr. Garcia, this is how we end up when we are caught short financially.

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: Traveler! What a coincidence!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: What are you doing here?

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: Haha. Why, I'm here for...

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: Trouble.

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: Valiant adventure! Please, Lutong, could you not...

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: As you wish, sir.

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: In truth, I'm here to look for Slime Condensate to use as the lubricant for my Numbering Machine.

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: Unfortunately, most of the Slime Condensate on sale is of low quality as it's kept for too long. Besides...

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: Mr. Garcia purchased too many books...

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: Oh come now, those were... necessary expenditures — that left us short of Mora, yes, but still!

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: That's why we came here, to collect some fresh Slime Condensate ourselves.

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: But as you can see, though our good Lutong is from Liyue, he knows neither martial arts nor culinary skills.

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: Fortunately, I have a gift for accounting... all thanks to the complex tax rules of the Ministry of Civil Affairs.

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: ...As for me, I can't possibly hit anyone with the components of my Numbering Machine.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Do you need my help?

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: Well, in a sense...

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: Yes.

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: Lutong, do we... um... do we have any Mora left?

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: Well, I believe we'll find a way to get by after we pay the Traveler.

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: Splendid. Traveler, I'd appreciate it if you could kindly retrieve some Slime Condensate for me.

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: Lutong, our Mora...

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: We'll get by, Mr. Garcia.

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: There is an old saying in Liyue, "When your path is blocked by a mountain, there will be a way through." I think this describes precisely where we are right now.

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: It means that when a mountain stands in our way, we will always find a way to get over it.

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: Aha! That's a clever metaphor. Then I suppose our situation is not quite so dire.

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: Still, Mr. Garcia, do you think the person who originally penned those words found a way across the mountain?

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: Eh? Come now, Lutong, don't jinx it...

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: Traveler, have you obtained the Slime Condensate?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Got it right here.

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: Wonderful! This should suffice. I'll continue my experiments once I return. With this as the lubricant, my Numbering Machine will definitely...

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: I must attend to my research now. Lutong, please take care of the remaining affairs.

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: Yes, sir.

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: Here's your payment, Traveler. Thank you ever so much for your help.

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: And um... in my humble opinion, we might be in need of your help in the future.

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: Rest assured. As long as the accounts are in my hands, you will be paid fairly.

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: *sigh* ...Actually, I came to travel with Mr. Garcia because I didn't want to spend my whole life doing accounts in a department of the Ministry of Civil Affairs like my parents do.

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: But now... in addition to working with Mr. Garcia on his calculations, I also need to help him sort out his accounts...

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: I guess this is what they call destiny...

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: Once again, Mr. Garcia, I sincerely suggest that we sell a few books to raise some Mora.

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: No! Not for the world! Lutong, my dear, you are asking me to put my soul up for sale!

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: But sir, no one bids for souls.

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: Oh, Traveler? What brings you here?

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: Um... My last experiment failed. There was something wrong with my dilution of the Slime Condensate...

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: Instead of lubricating the bearings of the Numbering Machine, the lubricant actually made them more likely to get stuck.

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: As such, I need more Slime Condensate for further experiments. Could you...

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: Traveler, please help us collect the Slime Condensate. I'll have your payment ready.

choices.text: Don't you have a way to earn Mora?

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: It's not that we don't...

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: It's a question of ability.

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: Thank you very much for this timely explanation, my dear Lutong.

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: Well, it's most certainly a shame... Although I have finished building the Numbering Machine, its functions are incalculably underwhelming.

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: It cannot even fully function as an automatic calculator, requiring manual aid to facilitate its operation.

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: But... I will enhance it! I firmly believe that my Numbering Machine will be a great invention!

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: An... An invention that heralds a new era! And after that, I'm sure I'll find a way to earn Mora...

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: H—However, before that...

choices.text: Do you need some more Slime Condensate?

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: Sir, this might be the place we're looking for. Now we just have to return with some hires...

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: Sir? Mr. Garcia, are you listening to me?

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: Yeah? Oh... Of course, I'm listening. Let's go back and hire someone. It won't take long.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is... is everything alright?

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: Traveler, ha... It's all right. I'm fine. Do I look I have a problem?

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: Now I am 100% committed to the research on the Numbering Machine, and I feel that I am only one step away from success.

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: If you're willing to help, would you please get some Slime Condensate for me?

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: Since you are here, I don't have to go back to the city to hire people. Now that I have made a little money now, I can offer you a better payment.

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: I will leave this part to you, Traveler. As for me, I have to think about how to change the structure of the mechanism...

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: Traveler, thanks for coming.

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: You're right, it's Ms. Kaia. Though Mr. Garcia doesn't talk about it, he gets distracted more and more often at work.

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: And he never went to that café again. Now he just asks me to buy it for him.

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: Even Mr. Ahangar came to tell me that he could talk to Mr. Garcia if it's necessary.

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: I don't know how to straighten Mr. Garcia out, as I have no experience dealing with this kind of situation.

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: *sigh* Looks like there is another hurdle in front of me and Mr. Garcia...

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: Traveler, have you obtained the Slime Condensate?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Got it right here.

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: Well, that's enough. Lutong, can you pay the Traveler first?

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: I need to check the quality of these Slime Condensate first...

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: Here's your payment, Traveler. Thank you for your help.

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: You are welcomed to swing by anytime.

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: If Mr. Garcia's mental state is too... unwell, maybe I'll need your help.
